sections.heading: Verbs that interpret what was said
sections.body:
At C1, reporting verbs don't just transmit — they show your reading of the speaker's intention:

- *alegar* (to claim, plead — often an excuse): *Alegó que no había recibido el aviso.*
- *insinuar* (to hint, insinuate): *Insinuó que yo había mentido.*
- *sostener / mantener* (to maintain): *Sostiene que el informe es falso.*
- *argumentar* (to argue a point): *Argumentó que el costo era excesivo.*
- *matizar* (to qualify, add nuance): *Luego matizó sus palabras.*
- *recalcar / subrayar* (to stress, underline): *Recalcó que la decisión era definitiva.*
- *desmentir* (to deny a report publicly): *El ministro desmintió los rumores.*
- *reconocer / admitir* (to acknowledge): *Reconoció haberse equivocado.*
- *reprochar* (to reproach): *Le reprochó que no la hubiera apoyado.*
- *sugerir* — with indicative = to imply; with subjunctive = to suggest: *Los datos sugieren que hay un problema.* vs. *Sugirió que esperáramos.*

sections.heading: Summarising a text or talk
sections.body: *El autor plantea que…* (The author raises / proposes that…), *Según el artículo…*, *El texto aborda el tema de…* (The text deals with…), *En líneas generales, sostiene que…* (Broadly speaking…), *La conferencia giró en torno a…* (The talk revolved around…), *En síntesis…* (In summary…). Use the present tense for what a text says: *El autor afirma…*

examples: Alegó que no había recibido el aviso.
He claimed he hadn't received the notice.
Insinuó que yo había mentido.
She hinted that I had lied.
Sostiene que el informe es falso.
He maintains that the report is false.
Argumentó que el costo era excesivo.
She argued that the cost was excessive.
Luego matizó sus palabras.
Later he qualified his words.
Recalcó que la decisión era definitiva.
She stressed that the decision was final.
El ministro desmintió los rumores.
The minister denied the rumors.
Reconoció haberse equivocado.
He acknowledged he had been wrong.
Le reprochó que no la hubiera apoyado.
She reproached him for not having supported her.
Los datos sugieren que hay un problema.
The data suggest there's a problem.
Sugirió que esperáramos.
He suggested we wait.
El autor plantea que la educación es la clave.
The author proposes that education is the key.
El texto aborda el tema de la desigualdad.
The text deals with the subject of inequality.
La conferencia giró en torno a la inteligencia artificial.
The talk revolved around artificial intelligence.
En síntesis, el autor defiende una reforma profunda.
In summary, the author defends a deep reform.

exercises.prompt: *desmentir* means…
*Los datos sugieren que hay un problema* — *sugerir* + indicative means…
*Alegó que no había recibido el aviso* suggests the speaker thinks it's…
*matizar* means…
When summarising what a text says, use…
The minister denied the rumors.
He acknowledged he had been wrong. (use an infinitive)
He suggested we wait.
The text deals with the subject of inequality.
